description:
Re-probed on develop 1d2b4f6fa by Bugs and Cleanup (2026-11-19). The if, case and else-clause shapes are fixed on all three paths. One shape remains: a rescue that joins a raw int with an atom.

a = try do
  if x, do: raise("boom"), else: :fine
rescue
  _ -> 10 + 10
end

Interp prints 20 then :fine, matching Elixir. Run and build panic at src/compiler2/native_codegen/fn_ctx.rs:847, 'cannot coerce atom and numeric raw ABI reprs'. When it was found on 5371db0a0, the panic was at fn_ctx.rs:443, 'known scalar kind does not match requested raw ABI repr', with the same atom-join-raw-int shape.

Done when the rescue form matches Elixir on all three paths, and fixture 00836 (filed as 00731, since renumbered) is restored to the shape it was rewritten to avoid.

comments.text: Proposal /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-bpd.html awaits the user. Root cause: TransportPosition::ResumePayload carries one callsite, filled by a rescan (required_resume_transport_positions) where the last call wins. Fix: ResumePayload { executable, entry }, recipe = origin_transport_recipe(value_origin(payload)) using body.rs delivered_value_joins; the rescan is deleted. Cost: distiller +1 request. New fixture 00898; 00836 restored.

title: A call returning a raw int can join a branch of another kind
